verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a cap table, equity management and valuation SaaS, not an AI agent or AI host application. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role that belongs to agent or assistant products, so the axis is a category error here. Nothing in the evidence shows Eqvista ships an AI assistant or any MCP client capability that would make the axis apply.
